cooksim.source_note: Existing formal_results_cache.json (G2 and G3), full-16 sq_v4 files.
cooksim.efficiency_definition: Per successful episode: (q1*Action + q3*Conversation)/(q1+q3). In-time successes only for all three efficiency columns. Per-run means, then mean across runs with successes.
cooksim.sd_definition: Population SD of three run-level success rates; not a confidence interval.
cooksim.streaming_labels: User confirmed native settings for VHHome and ScreenSim; unsuffixed API records retained. CookSim uses explicitly __native records only.
